caption:
MEXICAN WEEK BEGINS WITH MY ONE BOWL MEXICAN SALSA

This homemade spicy salsa can be made using a food processor and ready to serve in 5 minutes. 
This is perfect for light snacking with nacho chips and as an accompaniment in an indulgent mexican dish. 

This recipe is VEGAN!

Ingredients: 
2 medium tomatos
1 onion
2 green chillies
a few sprigs of coriander leaves
the juice of one lemon
1 tsp cumin powder
1 tsp grounud black pepper
1/2 tsp red chilli powder
salt, to taste

Add all your ingredients to a food processer and combine. 
You can drain out any excess liquid ( this way you dont need to deseed your tomatos and use everything up)

I use the @amazondotin food processor and it's so sturdy even when i overfill it sometimes 😅
